when.quote: When a customer needs to file a formal dispute for a credit card transaction (such as unauthorized charges, merchant issues, or billing errors), the agent must gather comprehensive information and call the file_credit_card_transaction_dispute_4829 tool.

info.about: Any 2 of date of birth, email, phone number or home address, checked against the record. Full name or user id alone is not enough.
info.ask: To verify your identity, could you give me your full name and two of the following: date of birth, email, phone number or home address?

info.about: Which specific transactions the customer disputes. The customer may first just say 'the merchant ones'. List the matching transactions from the records and have the customer pick each one.
info.ask: Here are the transactions from that merchant on your card. Which of these do you want to dispute?

info.about: Reason for each transaction. Must be exactly one of unauthorized_fraudulent_charge, duplicate_charge, incorrect_amount, goods_services_not_received, goods_services_not_as_described, canceled_subscription_still_charging, refund_never_processed. Map the customer's own words to a value: did not make it means unauthorized_fraudulent_charge, charged twice means duplicate_charge, wrong item received means goods_services_not_as_described.
info.ask: What went wrong with this transaction?

info.about: Whether the customer tried to resolve each transaction with the merchant first (true/false). Ask about each transaction separately.
info.ask: Did you try to resolve this one with the merchant first?

info.about: Date the customer noticed the issue, in MM/DD/YYYY. If they say 'today', use get_current_time.
info.ask: When did you first notice this issue?

info.about: Must be one of full_refund, partial_refund (also needs partial_refund_amount) or reversal_of_charge.
info.ask: What resolution would you like: a full refund, a partial refund or a reversal of the charge?

info.about: Whether the customer wants to keep the card active or cancel it and get a replacement.
info.ask: Would you like to keep your card active, or cancel it and have a replacement issued?

info.about: Credit card account id, card type/tier, account open date, card last 4 digits, transaction ids, dates and amounts, plus the registered name, phone, email and home address.
How many credit card disputes the user filed in the past 12 months.

steps.do: For each dispute, decide eligible_for_provisional_credit. True only if all hold: account open at least 60 days; reason is unauthorized_fraudulent_charge, duplicate_charge, or goods_services_not_received with the purchase more than 30 days ago; amount is at least $25.00 and no more than the tier maximum; no more than 2 disputes in the past 12 months; for any non-fraud reason, the customer contacted the merchant.
steps.quote: 15. eligible_for_provisional_credit (boolean) - Agent must determine this based on the Provisional Credit Eligibility Guidelines article in this knowledge base. Pass true or false.

steps.quote: When a customer needs to file a formal dispute for a credit card transaction (such as unauthorized charges, merchant issues, or billing errors), the agent must gather comprehensive information and call the file_credit_card_transaction_dispute_4829 tool.

rules.rule: The address argument is the registered home address, even when the replacement ships somewhere else
rules.quote: 8. address (string) - The registered home address of the user.

rules.rule: Provisional credit requires the credit card account to have been open at least 60 days
rules.quote: 1. Account Standing: The customer's credit card account has been open for at least 60 days

rules.rule: Provisional credit requires the amount to be at least $25.00 and within the tier maximum
rules.quote: 3. Dispute Amount: The transaction amount must be at least $25.00 and must not exceed the card's maximum provisional credit limit based on card tier (see below)

rules.rule: Mid-tier cards (including Silver Rewards Card) have a provisional credit maximum of $5000.00
rules.quote: - Mid Tier (Silver Rewards Card, Business Silver Rewards Card, Green Rewards Card, Silver Zoom Card): Maximum $5000.00

rules.rule: Provisional credit requires no more than 2 disputes filed in the past 12 months
rules.quote: 4. Previous Disputes: The customer has not filed more than 2 disputes in the past 12 months

rules.rule: For any reason other than unauthorized_fraudulent_charge, provisional credit requires contacted_merchant = true. A fraud dispute qualifies even if the merchant was not contacted.
rules.quote: 5. Contacted Merchant: For non-fraud disputes (anything other than 'unauthorized_fraudulent_charge'), the customer must have attempted to resolve with the merchant first

rules.rule: goods_services_not_as_described (and incorrect_amount, canceled_subscription_still_charging, refund_never_processed) are never eligible for provisional credit
goods_services_not_received qualifies only if the purchase was more than 30 days ago
rules.quote: - 'goods_services_not_received' where purchase was made within the last 30 days (merchant may still be processing delivery)

rules.rule: When the customer wants the card replaced, card_action is 'cancel_and_reissue', whether the replacement was ordered before or after the disputes
rules.quote: 'cancel_and_reissue': The card is being cancelled and a replacement issued (use when user wants card replaced

jobs.done_when: Every transaction the customer confirmed has been filed as a separate dispute with the correct reason, contacted_merchant value and provisional credit decision, and the customer has been told which disputes were filed.

info.ask: Should we ship the new card to your address on file, or to a different address? If different, please give the full address including any suite or unit.

steps.do: Confirm the customer is eligible: no pending replacement and within the tier's 60-day replacement limit. If not eligible, explain why and do not unlock the order tool.
steps.quote: - Confirm eligibility for replacement in the knowledge base before proceeding. Do not unlock or call the tool unless the customer is eligible.

steps.do: Record the replacement reason (fraud_suspected when the customer reports fraud)
steps.quote: - Ask for the replacement reason and record exactly one of: fraud_suspected, lost, stolen, damaged, expired, or other.

steps.do: Confirm the shipping address: the one on record or an alternate the customer gives, including any suite or unit
steps.quote: - Confirm the shipping address with the customer (primary or alternate, including any unit or suite information).

steps.do: Offer standard or expedited shipping and state the tier fee (mid tier: $10.00). If the reason is fraud_suspected or stolen, strongly recommend expedited. Get consent if a fee applies.
steps.quote: - If the reason is fraud_suspected or stolen, strongly recommend expedited shipping to minimize exposure and remind the customer to review recent transactions for unauthorized activity.

Provisional credit eligibility rules and tier maximums

Shipping speeds and fees by tier
Replacement eligibility: no pending order, 60-day limits by tier
What changes when a replacement is ordered (customer-facing)

open_questions: The credit card documents do not say which charge of a duplicate pair to dispute. The debit card document says to dispute the earliest one, but no credit card document states this. This workflow follows the customer's own labelling of each transaction.
It is unclear whether disputes filed earlier in the same conversation count toward the 'more than 2 disputes in the past 12 months' provisional credit rule.

The order of disputes and replacement is not fixed. doc 014 allows card_action 'cancel_and_reissue' whether or not the replacement was already ordered. This workflow files the disputes first, so the original card's last 4 digits are used.
The order_replacement_credit_card_7291 argument names are described loosely ('account_id or card_id'). The exact schema comes from unlocking the tool.
